renters.benefit.additional_living: Additional living expenses after a covered loss
coverage.bodily_injury.label: Bodily Injury Liability
coverage.bodily_injury.help: Helps pay covered costs when you are legally responsible for injuries to others in an accident.
coverage.bodily_injury.example: Example: the maximum benefit per person and per accident.
coverage.property_damage.label: Property Damage Liability
coverage.property_damage.help: Helps pay covered costs when you are legally responsible for damage to another person's vehicle or property.
coverage.property_damage.example: Example: the maximum benefit for each accident.
coverage.uninsured_motorist.label: Uninsured / Underinsured Motorist
coverage.uninsured_motorist.help: Provides benefits under the policy when the responsible driver has no insurance or insufficient limits.
coverage.uninsured_motorist.example: Availability and limits vary by state and policy.
coverage.collision_deductible.label: Collision Deductible
coverage.collision_deductible.help: The amount you pay before covered collision damage to your vehicle is paid.
coverage.collision_deductible.example: Example: a $1,000 deductible is subtracted from a covered repair payment.
coverage.comprehensive_deductible.label: Comprehensive Deductible
coverage.comprehensive_deductible.help: The amount you pay for covered theft, fire, or certain non-collision losses.
coverage.comprehensive_deductible.exampl: Covered events and exclusions are governed by the policy.
coverage.medical_payments.label: Medical Payments
coverage.medical_payments.help: Helps pay eligible medical costs for you and your passengers after an accident, subject to the policy.
coverage.medical_payments.example: Available limits and eligibility are governed by the policy.
coverage.rental_reimbursement.label: Rental Reimbursement
coverage.rental_reimbursement.help: Helps reimburse rental-car costs, up to daily and total limits, while a vehicle is repaired after a covered loss.
coverage.rental_reimbursement.example: Example: a daily limit and maximum number of days.
coverage.roadside_assistance.label: Roadside Assistance
coverage.roadside_assistance.help: Provides services such as towing, jump starts, or spare-tire changes according to the plan.
coverage.roadside_assistance.example: Service count, distance, and cost limits are governed by the policy.
coverage.glass_coverage.label: Glass Coverage
coverage.glass_coverage.help: Covers eligible windshield or other auto-glass losses under the policy.
coverage.gap_coverage.label: Gap Coverage
coverage.gap_coverage.help: For an eligible total loss, helps cover the difference between the vehicle settlement and qualifying loan balance.
coverage.gap_coverage.example: Eligibility, limits, and exclusions are governed by the policy.
